title: The first sock cymbal and the old low hat
summary: Sitting in at the sessions he saw the first sock cymbal on the floor; DeMichael recalls his own old low hat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Well, did you play in some of the sessions? Did you sit in --
Oh, yeah, right. And there was a first time -- we were talking about the sock cymbal?
That was the first one down on the floor. Yeah, right, right, right.
Yeah. I had an old low hat one time. I wish I had of kept it.
First set of drums. During the war, you couldn't get a --
So they had this old low hat in --
Right, and it had a thing like a (unintelligible), and then you put your foot on the wood and then a spring, (laughter.)
I wish I'd kept that thing.
